notes: First PL run 2026-11-02. Every entry page opened with WebFetch; aggregator pages (worldpetnet, znanylekarz, gost24, doweta etc.) used only to discover URLs. 24 h marked only where the clinic page says 24 h / całą dobę / całodobowo / 24/7; several are conditional (emergency duty or phone line outside regular hours) and say so in note: AMVET Kraków and Gdańsk, Luxvet24, UR Kraków, Giszowiec, Ołtaszyńska, OIOMVET (24 h only Fri-Sun), ARKA. Not marked 24 h despite wording: KORA Bydgoszcz (page says całą dobę but hours end in evening), Gdynia Stryjska (duty to 24:00 only; aggregators call it 24h), Bydgoszcz/Toruń Pogotowie (night 20-8, 24 h Sun/holidays, schedule not tied to a site), Witolińska Warszawa (7-23). Duty rotas: Poland has no national or chamber-run rota that could be opened; Krajowa Izba Lekarsko-Weterynaryjna page returned unreadable content and regional chambers were not reachable; only the City of Łódź list is included as duty_rota. Poison line: none included - no opened page names a real animal poison information line in Poland (human poison centres were not claimed to advise on animals). Koszalin: an advocacy page (vet-alert.org) reports that in Jan 2025 the Zachodniopomorska izba said no Koszalin clinic is registered as 24 h; no Koszalin/Kołobrzeg/Słupsk (Baltic coast) 24 h clinic included. Not done / left for follow-up: UP Wrocław SOR (announced for early 2026, kliniki.upwr.edu.pl pages returned errors), UP Poznań UCMW (robots disallowed), ZUT Szczecin (no clinic found), Warszawa Ursynów lecznica-ursynow.waw.pl and Morskie Oko (site redirect loop / not opened), VETS Warsaw, Bemowo, Vet Med Brwinów, Gdyński Szpital Weterynaryjny Kielecka 22 (only group news page, hospital 24/7 supervised), AMVET-group others; Gdynia/Sopot own-site 24 h clinics; Zakopane and Mazury 24 h clinics (none found); Białystok, Opole, Kielce, Zielona Góra, Olsztyn 24 h private clinics; regional chambers (okręgowe izby) duty pages; Piła Matuszewscy (24 h phone line only, not a clinic claim). Independent check 2026-11-02: opened source_url of all 31 24-h entries, the Łódź duty rota and 2 random other clinics (VetMaria, Bydgoszcz/Toruń Pogotowie) - 34 checked, 0 phones fixed, 0 downgraded, 0 removed. 24-h wording confirmed on every page (several conditional, see notes: OIOMVET Mon-Thu 8-24, AMVET/Luxvet24/Sosken/UR Kraków/Giszowiec/Ołtaszyńska emergency duty outside regular hours, Centrum Bydgoszcz night = emergencies only). Remaining ~7 other clinics not re-opened. Follow-up 2026-11-03 (regional / Baltic / Mazury): added 7 clinics (0 duty rotas, 1 conditional 24 h: AquaVet Zawada near Opole, 24 h claim only from the City of Opole page). Białystok (3), Zielona Góra (2), Gdynia (1) are ordinary clinics without 24 h wording. No okręgowa izba duty-rota page could be found or opened: the search tool did not surface any chamber pages, and fetch only works on URLs returned by search. The 2024 Opolskie voivodeship reply states there is no formal night vet service in Opolskie. Unreachable: aquavet.opole.pl and weterynarz.kielce.pl (robots disallow automated access), trojmiasto.pl AmVet page (client error), bialystok.oirl.pl (not retrievable). Gdynia Specialist Veterinary Clinic (ul. Paprykowa 12A, +48 536 300 490, no 24 h) only seen on LuxVet group page, not added. Not found at all: 24 h clinics in Białystok, Kielce, Zielona Góra, Sopot, Zakopane, Mazury (Olsztyn region, Mikołajki, Mrągowo, Ełk), Koszalin, Kołobrzeg, Słupsk, Hel/Władysławowo; searches returned only aggregators or job listings. Left: chamber duty lists (Białystok, Olsztyn, Kielce, Opole, Zielona Góra, Gdańsk/Gdynia), own-site research for these regions via a search tool that can surface clinic domains. Independent check 2026-11-03: opened source_url of all 7 new entries (AquaVet Zawada, Białystok x3, Zielona Góra x2, Gdynia) - 7 checked, 0 phones fixed, 0 downgraded, 0 removed; AquaVet 24 h wording (Całodobowy gabinet weterynaryjny) confirmed on the City of Opole page. Follow-up 2026-11-03 (chamber duty pages / Kielce / Mazury / Baltic): added 4 ordinary clinics (Kielce x3, Mrągowo x1), none with 24 h wording, 0 duty rotas. WebSearch with domain-style queries surfaced no okręgowa izba (wil.waw.pl, oilw, sil) duty page; only vetpol.org.pl legal PDFs. Wrocław city page 'jak znaleźć weterynarza dyżurnego' opened but its clinic list did not render (only confirms 24 h facilities exist and a planned UP Wrocław SOR). Pomorskie gov.pl wildlife-centre list opened: names Stryjska 25 Gdynia and Kartuska 249 Gdańsk with 9-21 hours, context only. Unreachable twice (http/https 302 redirect loop): bastet-kielce.com.pl, vet-mragowo.pl (Mrągowo Brudniccy), weterynarzkielce.pl (client error), trojmiasto.pl pages (client error). dmuchala.pl (Gdynia specialist) and other URLs not in search results cannot be fetched (provenance rule). Władysławowo clinics (Psia Kość, Droga Chłapowska 9; Babiarczyk, 8 Marca 2A) seen only on aggregator/town portals, not added. Nothing found for Sopot, Zakopane (beyond existing), Kołobrzeg, Koszalin, Słupsk, Świnoujście, Hel, Łeba, Mikołajki, Ełk: searches returned only KRS/price/job aggregators. Left: own-site clinic domains for these towns and chamber duty pages.
